title: The remark about replacing Tesh that people held against him
summary: Davison says his comment about finding a saxophonist meant that Teschemacher could never be replaced.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Let's back up one second now --

--- we've got to get this whole thing on here--- uh, there was also a comment or a remark that you made after the Tesh accident that some people held against you --- and that was when you said -- oh, what am I going to do for a clarinet player now --- or a saxophone player, whichever.

Well, if somebody made something of it, I said .-- where in the hell are we ever going to get a saxophone player like this guy. If we're reorganizing the band and getting someone to fill his place, how could it possibly ever be done---
Now, what's wrong with that remark?
Nothing is wrong with it but some people used that as a callus remark; they said, oh, all Davison
cares about is getting a clarinet player---or a saxophone player---
Oh, well, that's a pretty narrow minded people that would pick ---
But, that isn't what you meant---
No, it isn't what I meant. No. I said he couldn't be replaced, or words to that effect---
Okay - I just wanted to get that on because that has been brought up many times---
